role: Test suite author for Team 5 shared modules

tasks_completed.task: Read existing modules for interface patterns

tasks_completed.notes: Team 5 had already created bus_core.py and db_utils.py. Tests were adjusted to match actual interfaces and all 55 pass.

coverage_areas: sanitize_channel() with special chars, unicode, empty, long names
bus_write() atomic append, directory creation, field validation, size limits, error handling
bus_read() offset tracking, expired message filtering, partial line handling, binary mode
retry_on_busy decorator: success passthrough, retry on BUSY, max retries, exponential backoff, errorcode detection
init_db() WAL mode, busy_timeout, row_factory, directory creation
get_connection() WAL mode, busy_timeout (default and custom), row_factory, parent directory creation, cross-thread usage
ensure_schema() table creation, idempotency, multiple tables, data preservation
atomic_update() basic insert, basic update, SELECT result return, rollback on error, concurrent access serialization

key_findings.bus_core_interface: bus_write(bus_dir, channel, msg_type, body, team, agent_id, *, ttl=3600). Note: msg_type is NOT validated against VALID_MSG_TYPES by bus_write itself -- callers must validate. Default busy_timeout is 5000ms.
key_findings.db_utils_interface: atomic_update(conn, select_sql, update_sql, params) implements a read-modify-write pattern with BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Returns the SELECT row. get_connection default busy_timeout is 5000ms.
